summary_1line: Arjuna saves Satyaki by severing Bhurisravas’ arm, sparking a moral dispute, after which Satyaki kills the meditating, disarmed Bhurisravas.

image_candidates.scene_text: Arjuna’s razor-headed arrow flashes like a meteor and severs Bhurisravas’ sword-wielding arm as he prepares to behead the fallen Satyaki.
Bhurisravas, one arm cut off, sits on a bed of arrows in yogic meditation beneath the sun as armies watch in silence.
Satyaki rises and with a swift sword stroke decapitates the meditating Bhurisravas while warriors on both sides cry out in disapproval.
